summary: Clean, well-scoped implementation that reuses existing harness patterns: require_task_grill mirrors require_grill; the delegation gate sits at the single if-write choke point and DRYs the task_digest call; the board reuses task_dossiers/proof and the grills glob. Tests are non-parametrized (correct for JUnit id visibility). Docs accurately match shipped behaviour and even corrected a pre-existing inaccuracy (plan gate 'EVERY task' -> once per story).

non_blocking_findings.summary: Two upfront-decomposition mis-scopes surfaced mid-build: pr_ready task-grill archiving (deferred D-0013) and the launch_fake test helper (fixed) — each a file a task referenced but did not own. Ironically the exact failure this story's JIT gate prevents; expected for a bootstrapping story recorded the upfront way.
pr_links(base) is recomputed in both aggregate_state and story_detail; negligible, could be threaded through.
